en.headline: Poon Hao-ran claims Hong Kong's first Youth Olympics gold in wushu
en.dek: The 15-year-old wushu athlete scored 18.720 in the men's combined Taijiquan and Taijishan final in Dakar, marking the city's historic first gold at the Games.
body: Wushu athlete Poon Hao-ran won gold in the men's combined Taijiquan and Taijishan event at the 4th Youth Olympic Games in Dakar, Senegal, giving Hong Kong its first-ever gold medal in the history of the Youth Olympics.

The 15-year-old, a flag-bearer for the Hong Kong, China delegation, advanced from the preliminary round and scored 9.360 in both the Taijiquan and Taijishan segments of the final for a total of 18.720. Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law congratulated him on Wednesday, describing the result as historic and one that would make all Hong Kong citizens proud.

Law also congratulated table tennis pair Su Tsz-tung and Li Ki-ho on their silver in mixed doubles and swimmer Man Wui-kiu on her bronze in the women's 100m breaststroke. The Games run until 13 November, with Hong Kong sending 15 athletes across 12 sports.

zh.headline: 潘浩然青奧武術奪金 港隊史上首面青年奧運金牌
zh.dek: 15歲武術運動員在達喀爾男子太極拳太極扇全能決賽以18.720分奪金，為香港在青年奧運取得歷史上首面金牌。
body: 武術運動員潘浩然在塞內加爾達喀爾舉行的第四屆青年奧林匹克運動會中，奪得男子太極拳太極扇全能金牌，為中國香港隊取得青年奧運史上首面金牌。
15歲的潘浩然是港隊旗手，他由初賽晉級後，在決賽的太極拳及太極扇項目各取得9.360分，合計18.720分封王。文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩周三祝賀他，形容成績歷史性，全港市民以他為榮。
羅淑佩亦恭賀乒乓球運動員蘇籽童、黎驎豪在混合雙打奪銀，以及游泳運動員文薈喬在女子100米蛙泳奪銅。青奧至11月13日結束，港隊共派15名運動員出戰12個項目。
